parameters.request/body:
{
  "displayName": "@{outputs('Payload')?['displayName']}",
  "description": "@{outputs('Payload')?['description']}",
  "signInAudience": "@{outputs('Payload')?['signInAudience']}",
  "notes": "@{concat('appCatID=', triggerOutputs()?['body/AppCatId'], '; requestId=', triggerOutputs()?['body/Title'], '; createdBy=', outputs('Requester'), '; managedBy=', body('Get_settings')?['ManagedByTag'])}",
  "tags": @{outputs('App_tags')},
  "appRoles": @{body('Select_app_roles')},
  "api": { "requestedAccessTokenVersion": 2 },
  "web": { "redirectUris": @{if(empty(outputs('Payload')?['redirectUrisWeb']), json('[]'), split(outputs('Payload')?['redirectUrisWeb'], ';'))} },
  "spa": { "redirectUris": @{if(empty(outputs('Payload')?['redirectUrisSpa']), json('[]'), split(outputs('Payload')?['redirectUrisSpa'], ';'))} },
  "groupMembershipClaims": "@{outputs('Payload')?['groupMembershipClaims']}",
  "optionalClaims": {
    "idToken": @{body('Select_id_token_claims')},
    "accessToken": @{body('Select_access_token_claims')},
    "saml2Token": []
  }
}
